title: Load the matched save into Corova
purpose: Prove that a machine-authored task can wait for both runtimes, mirror startup/save-slot input, detect the shared town endpoint, and emit a paired review checkpoint.
setup: Start both runtimes from fresh processes with the same copied native save in slot 1.
Use the iPhone display tier and a DUMP-only TouchHLE observer at 250 ms or faster.
The task assumes the title screen has not already been dismissed.
reviewFocus: Confirm both sides select the same save slot and settle in Corova.
Compare town camera scale, building positions, labels, hero/XP chrome, and entry animation endpoint.
Treat the pixel heat map as a lead; use the paired state file for the machine verdict.

steps.note: Do not send the first mirrored tap until the controlled port and native observer are live.
Center-screen title action, recovered from the maintained native route.
First save-slot row in the 960x640 retina client surface.
Require the semantic endpoint to remain stable for 12 seconds because the native blue day banner is not represented in HSCENE.

steps.label: Corova settled
steps.note: Both runtimes reached the same source town after the same normalized input sequence.
